Skills · YinYang Empty

yinyang-empty

Keep reverse alignment, YinYang dialectics, and the formation methods; develop your own philosophy and personal version.

Empty includes the six formation guides, Core views as attributed suggestions, the practice overview, formation and revision, daily collaboration, and guidance for organizing Personal. It does not contain docs/ or diagrams/. The author's developed essays and diagrams remain in Full and on the website for optional reading.

Reverse alignment and crossed participation with dialectical return are shared core commitments of these editions. Other suggestions do not become your adopted philosophy merely because you installed the package. Your actual philosophy, personal material, and question-defined working models are formed with you, from your purposes, experience, sources, and environment. The model can carry the writing and implementation; you need not do it unaided.

This package is Empty, the own-philosophy row of the 2×2. Choose simple or complex in the practice selector. Its six status: unfilled starters, four empty Personal areas, and source index provide places for you and the model to form your content; see Files and updates.

The Codex installation guide offers yinyang-empty@boluopai. Choose Full or Empty for the same personal version, and keep personal additions outside replaceable plugin caches. Public method updates retain your own content; they do not install Full's philosophical corpus.

This is an edition of YinYang by boluopai, adapted by selecting its method resources and retaining developed essays as optional external reading. It retains CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Share adaptations under the same license, with attribution and changes identified; private adaptations need not be public.
